title: Mage Training Arena
subtitle: North of the Emir's Arena · four rooms, pizazz points per room
gearNote: Pizazz points aren't in the sync files; check them in game
facts: [[Minigame Teleport]] to the arena (unlock it by talking to the [[Entrance Guardian]]), or a [[Ring of dueling]] to the Emir's Arena and run north.
None missing. 94 Magic covers every spell; [[Lvl-6 Enchant]] is the one to use (Lvl-7 costs too much).
Law, cosmic and nature runes, plus earth and fire for Lvl-6 Enchant (you have 53k and 71k). [[Rune pouch]] {have:Rune pouch}.
Any staff that covers fire runes for alchemy, and earth for enchanting. [[Bones to Peaches]] is already unlocked, which nearly doubles Graveyard points.
Alchemist's Playground ~142k, Telekinetic Theatre ~65k. Low AFK in all rooms.

sections.title: How it works
items: Each room pays its own pizazz points, and every reward costs points from all four rooms.
**Telekinetic Theatre:** [[Telekinetic Grab]] the statue through a maze. 2 points per maze, 8 bonus every 5 in a row. Usually the slowest room.
**Creature Graveyard:** turn bones into peaches and deposit them. Dodge the falling bones.
**Enchanting Chamber:** enchant shapes and deposit the orbs. Points equal the spell level, doubled on dragonstones.
**Alchemist's Playground:** alch the item worth 30 coins; it moves every minute.

sections.title: Strategy
items: **Cosmics are your bottleneck:** 457 cosmics is about 2,700 Enchanting points with Lvl-6 Enchant, under half of the Mage's book's 6,000. Craft cosmics before a long Enchanting session.
**Natures:** Alchemist's Playground burns ~900 natures an hour. Your 2,834 cover the book's 550 points easily.
**Telekinetic:** realistically ~240 points an hour, so the Mage's book's 500 takes about 2 hours.
**Graveyard:** use Bones to Peaches, never Bananas.
